clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, a warlock faces a vital trial in Horde training: rescue a captured orc warrior. With Ken'zigla's Draught, you must find battered Grunt Dogran in a quilboar camp and give him strength to escape.

Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo will not risk Horde soldiers in a costly attack on the entrenched quilboar. Dogran's fate rests with you, an aspiring warlock armed only with Ken'zigla's Draught. Travel north through the brambles and hostile camps to find where the quilboar hold him captive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've made it this far, so if you want to see this through to the end, I won't stop you. I can't spare you any additional manpower though, you'll be on your own.
Dogran is being held in a quilboar camp to the north of here. Look for a group of two huts. He'll be heavily guarded—that is, if they haven't killed him yet, or he hasn't succumbed to his wounds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can feel the strength in me now, enough to hobble away... But my leg, I will have lost it for the rest of my life. My arm, too.
